policy.policy_note: Fixed research policies only. One frozen final look; extra variants/looks must join the multiplicity family. Minimum counts alone do not prove skill.

registration_note: Catalog membership reserves a multiplicity-family slot; it does not establish external preregistration.

metrics.method: NFL season-week cluster percentile bootstrap; all tickets in a week resampled together

V1_integrity.detail: External prediction receipts and official final outcomes independently rechecked

V2_effective_sample.detail: At least 200 settled tickets AND 20 season-week clusters (project screening policy)

V3_simultaneous_roi.detail: Positive multiplicity-adjusted lower net-return bootstrap limit, exact prices after costs

V4_holm_null.detail: One-sided null-centered block-bootstrap p, Holm across ALL registered variants

V5_independent_folds.detail: Two frozen non-overlapping holdouts, no test-set tuning or hindsight slicing

V6_calibration_benchmark.detail: Proper-score improvement against a contemporaneous normalized market baseline with uncertainty

V7_clv_support.detail: Positive matched-contract CLV support; CLV alone is never proof of profitability

V8_exposure.detail: Ticket and overlapping-event portfolio caps enforced; no duplicated legs as independent samples

V9_frozen_final_look.detail: One preregistered final decision date; no repeated significance peeking
